verdict.rationale: Kick's own MCP/CLI docs describe building workflows that run across every workspace. Rules and AI categorization act automatically on many matching transactions at once, which points to multi-item operations. There is no documented bulk-edit or batch action for selecting many transactions, bills, or invoices and changing them together. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch edit of selected items, documented batch endpoints or MCP/CLI bulk tools, limits and undo behavior for bulk changes, hands-on corroboration.
